entities.summary: Lintula Holy Trinity Convent or Lintula Convent is a small Orthodox Christian convent located in Palokki, Heinävesi, Finland. The current leader of the monastery is Abbess Ksenia. The monastery is the only Orthodox nunnery in the Nordics.
